gameDescriptionHtml:
FOXYBALL is a fun and easy-to-play game inspired by Football Penalty. Instead of playing against a goalkeeper, the goal is divided into 24 blocks, with a new random configuration for each attempt. To score, players will need a combination of luck, skill, and smart decision-making.

We’re not only creators but also players ourselves, and like many, we work hard everyday, striving to achieve our dreams and build our lives. We believe the true value of games is to offer relief and escape from exhaustion and pressures, not to burden players with repetitive, time-wasting tasks.

That’s why we created FOXYBALL to be a simple, relaxing experience—quick to learn, easy to play, and perfect for unwinding. It recaptures the charm and joy of the games we grew up with back in the 1990s and early 2000s, where players could jump right in and start having fun…

FOXYBALL is about instant fun and relaxation. The game offers 4 distinct play modes within: “Starlink” and “Starlight” are ideal for solo play, offering the perfect way to relax while challenging yourself to higher score; “Teamgeist” mode encourages teamwork, as you and your friends or family join forces to solve tricky challenges together; “Jackpot” mode offers a competitive and friendly battle where lets players face off in a tactical showdown.

FOXYBALL is an entertainment that fits any occasion—from solo play to family day or social events.
